description: Structured UI style families from UI UX Pro Max.

items.name: Bauhaus (包豪斯)
items.accessibility: ⚠ WCAG AA (high contrast primaries; verify yellow text separately)

items.name: Minimalist Monochrome
avoid_for: anything requiring visual warmth or gradient

items.name: Modern Dark (Cinema Mobile)
avoid_for: health/medical contexts where dark feels harsh
items.accessibility: ⚠ WCAG AA (requires careful accent contrast check)

items.name: SaaS Mobile (High-Tech Boutique)
avoid_for: contexts where Electric Blue feels too corporate

items.name: Kinetic Brutalism (Mobile)
avoid_for: any context where aggressive typography feels inappropriate
items.accessibility: ⚠ WCAG AA (verify zinc body text on dark bg)

items.name: Flat Design Mobile (Touch-First)
avoid_for: contexts where flat design reads as unfinished or sterile
items.dark_mode: ◐ Partial (Dark mode via color swap only)

items.name: Material You (MD3 Mobile)
best_for: data-heavy back-office UI with Material UI

items.name: Bold Typography (Mobile Poster)
avoid_for: contexts needing many icons or heavy imagery

items.name: Neumorphism (Mobile)
avoid_for: apps needing strong visual hierarchy via color
